{{External|rs=Headhunter's sacrifice}} {{Infobox Item |name = Expeditious bracelet |image = [[File:Expeditious bracelet.png]] |release = [[2 February]] [[2017]] |update = Silver Jewellery, Tournament World & QoL! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Check, Break, Drop |wornoptions = Check |examine = Allows one slayer kill to count as two. |value = 1150 |weight = 0.250 |exchange = Yes |id = 21177 }} [[File:Expeditious bracelet detail.png|left|140px]] The '''expeditious bracelet''' is an [[opal bracelet]] enchanted with the [[Lvl-1 Enchant]] spell. When worn, the bracelet provides a 25% chance for a monster killed to count as two kills toward the player's [[Slayer task]] without granting additional experience. The use of this is to speed up Slayer tasks the player does not particularly like doing. This effect is the inverse of the effect of the [[bracelet of slaughter]]. The bracelet only needs to be worn at the moment the monster is slain (more specifically, when the Slayer experience drop appears) for the effect to occur, so for the rest of the fight, players may wear other bracelets or gloves such as [[Barrows gloves]]. All expeditious bracelets share the same pool of 30 charges, with a charge consumed every time the worn effect is activated. (It is possible for a charge to be consumed on the last kill of a Slayer task.) When the last charge is consumed, the number of charges will reset to 30, and the worn bracelet will disappear. Dropping or [[Alchemy spells|alching]] a bracelet will ''not'' reset the shared charges; the only way to reset the charges at will is to use the right-click "break" option to sacrifice a bracelet early. In addition, the elite [[Combat Achievements]] rewards add a 10% chance for the bracelet to regenerate rather than disappearing, allowing it to be used for another set of charges. When this happens, a game message will state {{mes|Your expeditious bracelet helps you progress your slayer task faster. {{color|green|It then regenerates itself to full charge!}}}}. The number of charges for a given task can be estimated as C = \frac{x}{5}, where C is the charges required and x is the assigned Slayer count. For example, an assigned Slayer count of 180 results in: C = \frac{180}{5} = 36. Players can estimate the number of bracelets required per task by dividing the number of charges required by 30 and rounding up. In this example, the number of bracelets required is \left \lceil{\frac{36}{30}}\right \rceil = \left \lceil{1.2}\right \rceil = 2, so the player will need 2 expeditious bracelets. You can also simply divide the assigned Slayer count by 150 to receive the same answer. At the current price of the bracelet, the price per double kill is about {{Coins|{{GEP|expeditious bracelet|1/30|round=2}}}}. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = hands |image = [[File:Opal bracelet equipped.png|140px]] |altimage = [[File:Expeditious bracelet equipped female.png]] }} ==Creation== {{Switch infobox |text1 = Spell |item1 = {{Recipe |skill1 = Magic |skill1lvl = 7 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 17.5 |members = Yes |ticks = 3 |ticksnote = Manual casting is 3 ticks, auto-casting is 7 ticks |mat1 = Opal bracelet |mat2 = Cosmic rune |mat3= Water rune |output1 = Expeditious bracelet }} |text2 = Tablet |item2 = {{Recipe |members = yes |ticks = 1 |skill = No |mat1 = Opal bracelet |mat2 = Enchant sapphire or opal |output1 = Expeditious bracelet }} }} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Expeditious bracelet}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 4 September 2024 |update = Araxxor Tweaks & Poll 82 Updates |change = Expeditious bracelet now ensures players will receive the correct amount of [[Slayer point]]s when used with a [[Slayer partner]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 February 2017 |update = Party Pete's Birthday Bash |change = The item's inventory sprite was rotated, so that unenchanted silver jewellery now has non-standard angles instead. }} {{Subject changes |date = 9 February 2017 |update = Colourful Golems & Graphical Improvements |change = The "Break" option was added. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Expeditious bracelet (v1) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Expeditious bracelet detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Expeditious bracelet v1.png|center]] |[[File:Expeditious bracelet.png|center]] |- |2 February 2017 –
